artifacts.summary: Confirms the status-case collapse point in sapience-retrieve.sh, finds all 11 cited cold-start occurrences carry an identical retry_after:15 hint, recommends a single bounded retry with floor 1s/ceiling 20s/default 15s clamp, confirms orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh needs no change, and flags the test curl stub needs an additive two-response extension.

memory_candidates.content: The Sapience vault's cold-start 503 body (`{"error":"your Sapience is starting, try again in a minute","starting":true,"retry_after":15,"db_mb":0}`) was measured identically across 11 occurrences spanning two independent sessions 4 hours apart -- retry_after is a constant 15s hint for this vault, not a shrinking countdown, so a single retry at that delay is well-grounded rather than an arbitrary guess.

task-lock.sh establishes an env-overridable retry-constant convention (VAR="${VAR:-default}", e.g. TASK_LOCK_RETRY_BUDGET_MS) as an alternative to a plain fixed constant for new retry/timeout tunables in this codebase -- a precedent to reuse when adding a new bounded-retry constant to a shell script that already has fixed constants of its own.
